## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test` pass
- [ ] `npm run test:e2e` passes, if the runtime (`src/runtime/`) or output markup changed
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under "Unreleased" for user-visible changes
- [ ] `MEDIAKILN_CACHE_VERSION` bumped, if the output for an unchanged input changes
- [ ] README / `docs/DECISIONS.md` updated, if behaviour or a design decision changed
